surface: Exact exposed faces of selected voxel union; triangulated without smoothing or interpolation
voxel_convention: DX samples interpreted as cell centers with boundaries at plus/minus half a grid step
interpretation: Detection-region geometry only. Not physical empty volume, ligand accessibility, pocket-mouth size, or a MOF pore. Region IDs are threshold-local and are not matched to per-frame fpocket IDs or physiological sites.
boundary: Components touching grid edges are flagged as potentially truncated; their exported surface is closed at the grid boundary.
principal_dimensions: Bounding extents along uniform voxel-union principal axes; axes become nonunique for degenerate eigenvalues.
